overview: The Mustang Report features updates on Medford High School activities, including a vocational school open house, National Honor Society community initiatives, and a commemorative program for Veterans Day.

items.title: Vocational School Open House Preview
items.summary: Director Heidi Riccio announced an open house for November 12th focused on career and technical education and the dedication of a new health assisting lab.

items.title: National Honor Society Initiatives
items.summary: Students discussed a recent food truck fundraiser to purchase laptops for tutoring and the launch of the 'How to Survive High School 101' networking service.

items.title: Veterans Day Commemoration
items.summary: Social studies teacher Mr. Kane and several alumni veterans shared their military experiences and discussed the importance of connecting students with local service members.

items.title: Boys Soccer State Tournament Progress
items.summary: The varsity boys soccer team advanced to the state quarterfinals against Malden following a penalty shootout victory over Acton-Boxborough.
